extraction_notes: Supplementary tables/figures (table S1, table S2, fig. S1, fig. S2, fig. S18, fig. S19, etc.) are referenced by the paper but their contents were not supplied. Main-text Fig. 1 contains plotted performance trends for many compositions, temperatures, and stability time points; because most numeric values are not printed and dense plot readings would be imprecise, only the explicit numeric performance values stated in the text were extracted. CO + H2-only runs discussed for fig. S17 were excluded as CO hydrogenation, per instructions.
